components.name: Core Cooperative Semantics and Models

components.name: Public Frontend and Backend Registration

components.name: Documentation and CI Automation
components.description: Houses project documentation generation, cooperative visualization assets, and continuous integration validation scripts.

components.name: Continuous Integration Tooling
components.description: Automates CI workflows including change inspection, compile-time and SASS performance tracking, wheel validation, and notification reporting.

components.name: Compile Time Benchmarking and Change Inspection
components.description: Inspects modified CCCL subprojects to select CI test matrices and processes compilation traces into benchmark summaries and pull request comments.

components.name: CI Utilities and Notification Services
components.description: Provides pre-commit linters, failure analysis formatting, and Slack notification publishing for CI pipeline execution.

components.name: SASS Disassembly Analysis and Diff Reporting
components.description: Extracts, normalizes, and compares CUDA SASS disassembly from build artifacts to render assembly diff reports across revisions.

components.name: Build Performance Profiling and Packaging Validation
components.description: Profiles ninja build logs to report execution bottlenecks and validates python wheel packaging structure, provenance, and license bundles.

components.name: Sphinx Documentation Framework
components.description: Configures Sphinx-based documentation generation, generates API references from Doxygen XML, and provides interactive visualization scripts.

components.name: Sphinx Static Assets
components.description: Provides static JavaScript assets for interactive cooperative visualization, table-of-contents deduplication, and documentation search scoring.

components.name: Sphinx Configuration and Guides
components.description: Defines the core Sphinx documentation build settings, extensions, themes, and interactive Python walkthrough guides.

components.name: Custom Sphinx Extensions
components.description: Implements custom Sphinx extensions for automated Doxygen XML API reference generation and cooperative primitive visualizations.

components.name: NVRTC Device Compiler
components.description: Compiles device source code and extracts PTX symbols into device binaries dynamically via NVRTC.

components.name: Clang-Tidy Type Trait Plugins
components.description: Implements custom Clang-Tidy AST matchers and linter plugins to enforce and modernize type traits across the codebase.
